moments.title: Community Shield returns to Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, is set for Sunday, August 16, 2026, at Cardiff's Principality Stadium.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts kick-off
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing! The Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield this Sunday as Arsenal and Man City kick off the season. Who's making the trip to the Welsh capital? #CommunityShield

angles.name: Season curtain-raiser
angles.copy: The football season officially kicks off! Arsenal take on Manchester City in the Community Shield this Sunday. Who are you backing for the first silverware of 2026/27?

angles.name: Road closures reminder
angles.copy: Heading to the Community Shield in Cardiff this Sunday? Remember road closures around Principality Stadium start from 10am. Plan your journey!

moments.title: Roots Picnic London debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl in London this weekend, August 8-9, celebrating hip hop, music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Hip Hop in Crystal Palace
angles.copy: London! The legendary Roots Picnic lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend for its international debut. Who's ready for two days of incredible hip hop and culture?

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: From Philly to London, the Roots Picnic is bringing its unique blend of music and community to Crystal Palace Bowl this Saturday and Sunday. Expect world-class performances!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made history, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: Longest-running #1
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, with 19 weeks at the top. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: Still at the top
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean continues its historic run at UK Number 1. What a track!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's new album dominates trending chart
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' is making waves, with tracks like 'petal' (heading for #3) and 'kiss me' (heading for #6) dominating the Official Trending Chart this week.

angles.name: Ariana's album taking over
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' is taking over the charts! 'petal' and 'kiss me' are both looking strong for big debuts. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Trending tracks
angles.copy: Two new Ariana Grande tracks from 'petal' are dominating the Official Trending Chart! What's your favourite from the new album?

moments.title: UK heatwave expected next week
moments.blurb: Forecasters predict a potential heatwave across the UK next week, with temperatures possibly soaring above 37C in some southern and western areas around August 13-14.

angles.name: Heatwave incoming
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious heat! A UK heatwave is on the cards for next week, with temperatures potentially hitting over 37C. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: Devon heat warning
angles.copy: Devon, prepare for the heat! Temperatures could soar next week as a heatwave builds across the UK. Keep an eye on the forecast and stay safe in the sun.
